description: This file defines a Java interface 'ProjectDao' which declares methods for retrieving, saving, and removing 'Project' entities in a database layer of the application.

classes.name: ProjectDao
classes.description: Interface that declares data access methods for Project entities.

methods.name: retrieveProject
methods.description: Retrieves a Project object by its project ID.

methods.name: saveProject
methods.description: Persists the given Project object to the database.

methods.name: removeProject
methods.description: Removes the Project identified by project ID from the database.
